posts.name: Pavan K Rao
posts.cooked:
Hi i am Pavan K Rao , diploma level student and registered for system commands course in Jan 2026 term. BPT-1 i could not do due to time constraints but i did submit BPT-2 and also got

“Passed tests: 28/28
Public Test Cases: Evaluation successful.
Public Test Cases: Submission successful.
Private Test Cases: No Private Testcases found.”

I have also attached the screenshot of the same below

I have done everything right as said in README file ,iit dashboard tutorial video and whatever question came by typing synchro show command.

Screenshot 2026-03-19 2016101890×865 77 KB

Please help me here to know what can be done now or why is it so that it shows i was absent because without this submission i will not be eligible for oppe

thank you

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Each BPT has 4 question namely - BPT1_problem_1, BPT1_problem_2, etc. similarly BPT2 questions are named as BPT2_problem_1, BPT2_problem_2, etc.
You have solved second question from the first BPT (for which deadline is already over) and not from the second BPT. Hence, BPT2 marks are 0.

Regarding the question name, it was already clarified in mail and discourse post -

BPT-2 Released Announcement - Deadline-13 March 2026 23:59 PM IST System Commands
Dear students, Your 2nd BPT release is available on the course VM. You can access it through your course VM. There are four questions you can see: /opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_1 /opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_2 /opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_3 /opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_4 I am attaching a screenshot for your reference: [image.png] The deadline is 13th March. Please ensure you solve all the questions before 13th March. BPT is important because, to be eligible in OPPE, your average of the fi…
